in_hebrew.name: Laughton
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Town by the lea or river
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Laughton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘locan’ meaning ‘a hollow’ and ‘tun’ meaning ‘enclosure’ or ‘town’. The name Laughton can be translated to ‘town by the lea or river’. The name was common in the Anglo-Saxon and medieval periods.
